description: 臺中市主要道路喬木植栽 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府建設局. 臺中市主要道路喬木植栽資料提供了市民對於城市綠化的參考資料，內容涵蓋了各個區域的主要道路喬木植栽資訊，包括植栽數量、樹種類型、植栽位置等。 這些資料可以幫助市民了解城市的綠化情況，同時也可以提供給研究人員、都市規劃師等相關專業人士的參考資料。 這些資料也可以用於城市綠化規劃、環境教育等方面的應用。. Coverage: 臺中市政府建設局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府建設局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
